name: hunt-mobile
description: Mobile-app vulnerability hunting for Claude Code. /hunt-mobile decompiles an APK/IPA, runs an LLM-SAST pipeline (decompile -> scope filter -> risk-identify -> deep scan -> exploit -> MASVS report), and auto-loads the matching mhunt-* skills from 26 Android/iOS vulnerability classes. Ported from droid-llm-hunter's vuln_rules.
